description: This file defines the ContactFeed class which extends FeedLogicBase to handle specific feed logic for Contact modules in SuiteCRM. It primarily implements the pushFeed method to generate and push feed entries when contacts are created.

classes.name: ContactFeed
classes.description: A class extending FeedLogicBase, responsible for managing feed updates related to Contact records in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Creates a feed message when a new contact is created and pushes it using SugarFeed::pushFeed2.
